name: API Key Middleware
description: Per-API-key endpoint allowlist (HTTP method + path) for the Jellyfin API.
overview: Limits what each API key can call, with a point-and-click rule builder.

versions.changelog: Enforce mode: a WebSocket upgrade is only allowed on /socket with a GET /socket rule (Jellyfin accepted upgrades on any path, so any allowed GET rule could open a WebSocket). Rule builder: rules whose * also matches admin-only endpoints are marked and warned about. Docs: security boundary, fail-open table, updated limitations.

If Jellyfin resets the plugin configuration to the factory default because it cannot read it, the last saved rules are restored from a backup file next to the configuration (logged as a Warning). Docs: unreadable-configuration limitation, observed-list cap. CI actions pinned to commit SHAs.

Built for Jellyfin 12.4.0; the plugin version now follows the Jellyfin version. Control characters are removed from logged path templates. Docs: security policy, uninstall/rollback, review note for pre-selected endpoints. License: GPL-3.0.
